title: lupinus sericeus subsp. marianus
intro: Lupinus sericeus subsp. marianus, commonly known as Silver Bush Lupine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the legume family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its ability to lower cholesterol levels and blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Silver Bush Lupine are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and hypertension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
